stories.title: JI threatens march to Islamabad in mid-November if petroleum levy not abolished
stories.brief: Jamaat-i-Islami (JI) Emir Hafiz Naeemur Rehman on Monday warned that the party would march to Islamabad in mid-November if Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif did not abolish the petroleum levy.

stories.title: JI to march on Islamabad in mid-November if govt fails to end petroleum levy: Hafiz Naeem
stories.brief: Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) Pakistan Ameer Hafiz Naeem ur Rehman on Monday warned that his party would march towards Islamabad in mid-November if the government failed to abolish the petroleum levy and provide relief to the public.

stories.title: Imaan, Hadi move SC against IHC order refusing to stay trial in security breach case
stories.brief: The plea argued that the trial court proceeded with unprecedented haste by recording the examination-in-chief of six prosecution witnesses on Oct 10 and 14, and accepting the prosecution’s request to shift the trial to jail.

stories.title: Central bank raises policy rate by 50 basis points to 12pc
stories.brief: The State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) on Monday raised the key policy rate by 50 basis points to 12 per cent, its first increase since April as inflation, fuelled by high energy costs due to the Gulf conflict, remained above target.

stories.title: Imaan Mazari, Hadi Chattha move SC seeking suspension of ATC trial
stories.brief: Human rights lawyers Imaan Mazari and Hadi Ali Chatha on Monday approached the Supreme Court against an Islamabad High Court (IHC) decision concerning their request to halt trial proceedings in an anti-terrorism case.

stories.title: LHC disposes of petition seeking release of Imran Khan's sisters after detention extended
stories.brief: The Lahore High Court (LHC) on Monday disposed of a petition seeking the release of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) founder Imran Khan’s three sisters after the Punjab government informed the court that their preventive detention had been extended for another 30 days.

stories.title: SBP raises policy rate by 50bps to 12%
stories.brief: "The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) decided to increase the policy rate by 50 bps to 12 per cent in its meeting today, with the majority decision of nine out of ten members, with effect from October 27, 2026," the central bank said in a statement.

stories.title: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing
stories.brief: Data centres are the lifeblood of our digital world, but there are growing concerns about their environmental impact.

stories.title: Pakistan rejects ‘baseless’ civilian casualty claims by Afghan Taliban
stories.brief: Islamabad accuses the Afghan Taliban of harbouring ⁠militants ​who launch attacks in Pakistan, ​although Kabul denies this, calling the militancy its neighbour's domestic problem.

stories.title: Pakistan condemns 'reprehensible' Houthi attacks in Makkah, Madinah regions
stories.brief: Pakistan on Monday strongly condemned "reprehensible" Houthi ballistic missile attacks on October 24 which targeted the Makkah and Madinah regions of Saudi Arabia, including areas in the vicinity of the holy sites, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs said.

stories.title: Former army chief Abdul Waheed Kakar passes away in Rawalpindi: ISPR
stories.brief: Chief of Army Staff (COAS) and Chief of Defence Forces (CDF) Field Marshal Asim Munir on Monday expressed deep sorrow over the passing of former COAS (Retd) General Abdul Waheed Kakar who passed away in Rawalpindi, the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said.

stories.title: PM says poverty must not block education
stories.brief: Addressing the launch ceremony of the Prime Minister's Youth Chromebook Scheme, Shehbaz said providing modern educational facilities and technology to the country's youth was a collective responsibility and essential to preparing them for an increasingly technology-driven world.

stories.title: Stunning photos capture October's Hunter's Moon around the world
